headline: After 17 Years of Care, Daughter-in-Law Recovers Speech and Movement
meta_description: A 68-year-old woman's unwavering dedication helped her daughter-in-law recover function after a truck accident left her in a vegetative state.
summary_short: For 17 years, Xuan Fengying cared for her daughter-in-law after a truck accident. Now the woman can speak and walk again.
body:
After 17 years of devoted care, Xuan Fengying's daughter-in-law has regained the ability to speak and walk—a recovery that seemed impossible after a truck accident left her in a vegetative state.

Xuan, now 68, never abandoned hope or her commitment to her daughter-in-law during nearly two decades of round-the-clock care. Her persistence and love created the conditions for an extraordinary second chance at life.

When her daughter-in-law finally found her voice again, her first words carried the weight of gratitude: a simple acknowledgment of the woman who refused to give up—"Mum, g..."—the beginning of a conversation long thought lost forever.
quick_facts: Truck accident left daughter-in-law in vegetative state
Woman now able to speak and walk again
